pages.title: Natural Water Only
pages.text: You can only catch fish in $(bold)natural$() water: rivers, oceans, beaches, or large natural lakes (64+ connected water blocks).$(br2)Player-made ponds never yield fish!

pages.title: Real Fish Entities
pages.text: You can only catch fish if real fish entities exist near your hook. When you catch one, an actual fish entity is pulled to your feet - kill it to get the drops. Each catch consumes one fish from the area.$(br2)$(bold)Note: junk and treasure are not affected.$() With no fish around, a fish roll comes up empty, but you can still pull up $(bold)junk$() like lily pads, leather boots, bones or bamboo, or $(bold)treasure$() like name tags, saddles, books or nautilus shells.

pages.title: Feeding Fish
pages.text: Drop seeds or crops into natural water to feed the fish. After 0.5~1 in-game day, 2~5 fish will spawn at that spot. This lets you build your own fishing grounds!
